title: geometry/tsp for the knot/cuts/shell cluster, geometry/grid2d for the 2D grids, and common/ emptied
description:
Repo plan phase 1.6 (moves). The TSP code (knot, cuts, shell, point) is unrelated to the mesh code. Move knot, cuts (+engines, enums), shell, PointND/PointSet and DistanceMatrix under geometry/tsp; the .ix solution format methods of platform/file/FileManagement (importFromFile, addPoints, rewriteSolutionFile, appendAns, appendCutAns, writeSubGraphTest) plus PointSetPath and FileStringable into tsp; the TSP-only exceptions (BalancerException, SegmentBalanceException, InvalidCutException, MultipleCyclesFoundException, IdDoesNotExist, IdsNotConcurrent) into tsp; StringBuff to its one caller's package; TerminalParseException to gui/terminal; InvalidMeshTopologyException to mesh representation. The terminal 'add' primitives (Arc, Circle, Line, Triangle, Ix, PointCollection, GeometryMap) go to gui/terminal (or tsp/input). geometry/point Grid and IrregularQuadGrid plus game/IrregularQuadLayoutGenerator to geometry/grid2d (the merge of the two irregular grids is a separate step). common/ is deleted once empty.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. common/ no longer exists; geometry/point holds nothing or only what the ticket names.
2. Behaviour is unchanged: the unit suite passes, every scene in CanvasSceneMap still launches, and the generated registries (MeshNodeRegistry, SceneRegistry, CommandRegistry, AutomationRouteRegistry) and automation_routes.json list the same ids as master. Moved packages carry their package-info.java, and ARCHITECTURE.md is regenerated by SpliceArchitectureDoc. No class is renamed.
3. The TSP scene loads and solves a .ix file as before; IrregularGridScene draws.
4. Launch entry and screenshot.

5. The .ix methods move into geometry/tsp/PointSetPath verbatim, carrying their existing error output (the e.printStackTrace() calls of rewriteSolutionFile, removeDuplicates, appendAns and writeSubGraphTest, and addPoint's 'Duplicated found' line); removing that output is behaviour change outside this move.

Carried lines, as written: e.printStackTrace(); and ex.printStackTrace();

2. Live: ixdar-canvas with djbouti; terminal add/load commands; irregular-grid scene.

changes-made: Moves only, no class renamed, no logic touched (50 classes moved; references rewritten by a scripted import pass). geometry/knot, cuts (+engines, enums), shell -> geometry/tsp/{knot,cuts,shell}; PointND, PointSet -> tsp/points; terminal add primitives Arc, Circle, Line, Triangle, Ix, PointCollection, GeometryMap -> tsp/input (not gui/terminal: the .ix parser in tsp calls their parse methods); BalancerException, SegmentBalanceException, InvalidCutException, MultipleCyclesFoundException, IdDoesNotExistException, IdsNotConcurrentException, PointSetPath, FileStringable -> geometry/tsp; StringBuff -> tsp/shell (its one caller, Shell); TerminalParseException -> gui/terminal; InvalidMeshTopologyException -> geometry/mesh/data/representation; Grid, IrregularQuadGrid, game/IrregularQuadLayoutGenerator -> geometry/grid2d (not merged). The .ix methods (importFromFile, addPoint, addPoints, rewriteSolutionFile, removeDuplicates, appendAns, writeSubGraphTest, FileInfo, ANS/SUBGRAPH constants) moved from FileManagement into PointSetPath with their names kept; FileManagement no longer imports Toggle or any tsp type. appendCutAns had no caller and was deleted (checkstyle hook). common/ and geometry/point are gone. New package-infos for tsp, tsp/points, tsp/input, grid2d; geometry, game, platform/file, gui/terminal, representation, tsp/shell package-infos updated; ARCHITECTURE.md regenerated. Verified: mvn test 521 run, 0 failures; Geometry (6), Command (28), Scene (19), MeshNode (104 + 20 desktop), AutomationRoute (51) registry ids and automation_routes.json identical to mesh-58; ixdar-canvas loads djbouti and solves, terminal 'add circle' writes the CIRCLE line to temp.ix, 'ld djbouti_8-34' loads and solves; irregular-grid-canvas draws.
